Vietnamese National Holiday 2/9
Sep 2025 • Family
My family and I had an absolutely fantastic time at the Akasha Chinese Restaurant, located within the Poseido Hotel. We visited during the Vietnamese National Holiday on the 2nd of September, and the vibrant atmosphere made our dining experience truly special.

The restaurant was buzzing with positive energy and a festive spirit. The staff were all incredibly friendly and attentive, making us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. Most importantly, the food was excellent. Every dish was prepared to perfection, and the flavors were authentic and delicious.

We were so impressed by the combination of the wonderful food, the kind staff, and the overall celebratory vibe. It was the perfect place to celebrate the holiday, and we highly recommend the Akasha Chinese Restaurant to anyone looking for a memorable meal.
